correctness.rationale: Reconstructing the complete distributional variation proves the one-input identity; the minmod secant is a convex combination of three affine gradient selectors. Each step input affects at most two adjacent cell slopes, giving exact step variation 1+lambda(a+b) and hence the all-dimensional bound. Distinct explicit input pairs reach each case. Exact rational checker verifies arithmetic and witnesses; no finite experiment substitutes for universal proof.

value.rationale: Variation preservation of each separately reconstructed signal does not constrain variation of their difference. This theorem resolves that natural reconstruction-robustness gap sharply for all real signals, cell counts and limiter strengths, identifying the first expansive dimension and a precise factor-three instability with simple witnesses. The result directly informs propagation of BV perturbations through limited reconstruction.
